lead: A plain `php tools/dump-php-builtins.php` writes a *smaller* inventory than the committed one, and growing it drops `check-migration.py` under its `--min 100` floor.
body: The Windows build ships `fileinfo` and `zip` as DLLs its `php.ini` does not enable, and every name a regeneration adds is `open` until `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md` rows it. Pass `-d extension=` per DLL, diff the `# extensions:` header, and row the new names in the same slice.
